caption: A match is set to a pile of dry leaves, and the fire spreads across the pile with smoke rising from it.

sa.check: A match is set to the pile.
The flames spread outward from where the match touched.

pc.expect: The burn advances outward from the lit spot and burnt leaves stay black and shrunken.
pc.fail: Blackened leaves turn green or pale again; or the flame front retreats leaving unburnt leaves behind it; or the fire starts at a spot no flame reached; or ash gathers back into whole leaves.

pc.expect: The flames point upward from the pile and the smoke rises, while ash and burnt fragments settle down.
pc.fail: The flames point downward into the ground; or the smoke sinks and pools around the pile; or burnt fragments rise steadily and stay aloft; or the flames hang below the pile.

pc.expect: The leaves in the pile are the leaves that burn: they shrink to ash rather than vanishing at a stroke, and none appear.
pc.fail: The pile vanishes in a single frame while still whole; or new leaves appear on the burning pile; or a leaf vanishes leaving no ash; or the pile grows as it burns.

pc.expect: Where the flames reach, the leaves darken, curl and smoke, and leaves the flames have not reached stay dry and pale.
pc.fail: Leaves far from the flames blacken while those in the flames stay pale; or the flames pass over leaves and leave them green and flat; or smoke rises from a part of the pile with no flame or char.

pc.expect: The pile stays a pile of leaves that burns down and the ground below stays ground.
pc.fail: The leaves turn into another material as they burn; or the ground opens up under the pile; or a second pile appears already burning; or the flames pass through the ground.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The ground around the pile and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The ground changes texture away from the fire; or the background changes between frames; or the unburnt leaves change colour.

note: Who strikes the match is not judged.
